title: A line of the monthly vote review
description: data/votes/monthly/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl: what one month's vote review decided, written by `pnpm hits:monthly --ingest`. A reread line is an A stretch hit among the most voted that the review read again, with its decision and the sentence for it; one that stays is kept, never discarded. A suggestion line is an Interesting hit among the most voted, listed for the operator as a Greatest Hits suggestion; nothing makes it one but the operator's named decision. Votes are as the daily counts of `counts` gave them.

month.description: The UTC month the review belongs to.

counts.description: The date of the daily counts in data/counts/ the votes were read from; its meta.json states the counting convention.

rank.description: Its place in its section by votes, most first, a tie going A to Z by input and then by anagram, as the site orders a section.

decision.description: A reread line's decision: move to Interesting with the tag shelf:interesting, or stay in A stretch.

reason.description: A reread line's one sentence, written for this anagram alone.

monthly_version.description: The version of tools/hits/prompts/monthly.md the reread followed.
